title: Joining Ben Watkins, Vernon Alley and Sid La Prade in Oakland
summary: Music was slow in Oakland; he gigged with Ben Watkins, Vernon Alley, Wilbur Barranco and pianist Sid La Prade.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
